QuestInfo.name: Omens of Collapse
QuestInfo.0: You discovered a structure that looks to be a piece of a building from Seoul in Aqua Road. It may be dangerous if left alone. Ask #b#p1531011##k what to do.
QuestInfo.1: The buildings are the result of dimensional collapse. You need to put up a barrier to prevent further collapse. Check the rest of Aqua Road.
QuestInfo.2: You've put up barriers against the collapse, but it is enough? Will the sinkhole produce more of these anomalies as it gets more powerful?
